# frontend

Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19) UI for the hackathon starter: the case input, "Load sample case",
the agent run with human approval, and the live **Agent trace** panel (SSE from the FastAPI backend).
**Read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first**; `frontend/AGENTS.md` is generated by Next and stays as is.

| Script                                  | What it does                                                                           |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`                           | Dev server on :3000 (or `bash ../scripts/dev.sh` for API + UI together)                |
| `npm run lint` / `npm run format:check` | ESLint (Next + jsx-a11y strict) / Prettier                                             |
| `npm run typecheck`                     | `tsc --noEmit` (strict)                                                                |
| `npm test`                              | Vitest + Testing Library (`src/**/*.test.tsx`)                                         |
| `npm run test:e2e`                      | Playwright demo path + axe; starts its own API (`LLM_MOCK=1`) on :8788 and UI on :3100 |

Env: `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (default `http://localhost:8787`). It is public by design; never put keys in `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`.
